readme: Import stubs must save TOC in their  nid dispatch()  function or all subsequent TOC-relative loads crash.
No-oping dcbz creates infinite loops (CTR computed from huge byte counts) and leaves memory regions uninitialized, causing later crashes.
The game still initializes correctly because the constructors that crash are non-essential.
Root cause of most constructor crashes.
